text: 金十数据10月2日讯，津巴布韦财政部长恩库贝表示，津巴布韦计划取消食品进口关税，以帮助缓冲厄尔尼诺天气模式可能造成的作物短缺对价格的影响。该措施是这个南部非洲国家将推出的一揽子计划的一部分，旨在缓冲这种气候冲击以及中东和俄乌冲突推高食品和燃料价格对生活成本的影响。他周五在津巴布韦第二大城市布拉瓦约对记者表示：“我们有一个六大或七大支柱战略。”他补充称，2027年经济增长仍预计为5%。
text_en: Jinshi Data, October 2 — Zimbabwe Finance Minister Ncube said Zimbabwe plans to scrap tariffs on food imports to help cushion the impact on prices of possible crop shortages caused by the El Niño weather pattern. The measure is part of a package the southern African country will roll out to cushion the impact of this climate shock, as well as the impact on the cost of living from higher food and fuel prices driven by conflicts in the Middle East and between Russia and Ukraine. "We have a six- or seven-pillar strategy," he told reporters on Friday in Bulawayo, Zimbabwe's second-largest city, adding that economic growth is still expected to be 5% in 2027.
